description: Generate an EU electronic invoice from an EN 16931 invoice object. Set standard to the target format and pass the invoice fields. Use only invoice data the user gave. When a field the target format requires is missing, ask the user for it: do not make up a value so that validation passes. output 'xml' (default) returns the document inline; 'pdf' needs outputPath to write it to, and is a hybrid PDF/A-3 with the XML embedded for facturx and zugferd, or a visualization with no embedded XML for xrechnung and peppol-bis (whose legal document stays the XML). By default the API validates the document before returning it (verify), and a document that fails comes back as an error that lists the failed rules. validationResult carries the verdict, with the check depth of that validation in verificationBadgeLabel. beliq produces the document and does not send it: delivery through beliq is in development. Until it is available, transmission (Peppol, plateforme agréée, SDI) and tax-authority reporting stay with your access point; archiving stays with you, and beliq does not operate KSeF submission.

facturxProfile.description: Profile for a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD document; ignored for xrechnung and peppol-bis. extended-ctc-fr is Factur-X only: zugferd accepts basicwl, en16931 and extended.

invoice.description: The EN 16931 invoice to render. Extra fields (dueDate, buyerReference, paymentMeans, taxSummary, per-country blocks) are passed through to the API.

unitCode.description: UN/ECE Rec 20 unit code, e.g. HUR (hour), C62 (unit).

vatCategoryCode.description: UNCL5305 VAT category, e.g. S, Z, E.

output.description: 'xml' (default) returns the document inline. 'pdf' needs outputPath to write it to: for facturx and zugferd it is a hybrid PDF/A-3 with the XML embedded; xrechnung and peppol-bis have no hybrid form, so it is a visualization with no XML inside it, and their legal document stays the XML.

outputPath.description: Where to write the generated document on disk. Required for pdf output, optional for xml. The call fails if a file already exists at the path.

verify.description: Validate the generated document before returning it, and fail if it does not pass. Defaults to true.

name: beliq_generate_einvoice

franceCtcBlockingRuleIds.description: French CTC rule ids the API reports as ending a transmission through a French platform. Present also where valid is true, and never empty: when present, lead with it.

pdfInput.description: Present when the document was a PDF: which embedded file the verdict is about. containerChecked is always false, because the PDF itself is not checked.

valid.description: Whether the document passed the rule packs and schemas beliq runs for its format, in the versions this result names. Not a statement that every recipient or tax authority accepts it.

verificationBadge.description: Id of the check depth. Compare this, not the label.

verificationBadgeLabel.description: The check depth as English display text. Print it as it is. Absent when the API states no depth for this verdict: then say the check depth was not stated, and name none.

verified.description: False only when no ruleset ran (generate with verify: false). Then valid says nothing about the document.

title: beliq: Generate E-Invoice
